methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Exact shortest ADD distances for all 36 GL2-twisted isolated four-wire bank exchanges; source-bound floor for the fixed-chain isolated-exchange factorization of PR5840.
scope_change_reason: The three candidates were G20 helper splitting, scalar route synthesis and changed decoder paid profiles. Existing common-frame exclusions and live source synthesis overlap led to the released equal-target basis question. This narrows the general GL2 question to isolated exchange factors; the signed recursive moment is unchanged.
bottleneck_link: A scoped negative result for BIT boundary work: even with arbitrary GL2 endpoint bases, each isolated exchange needs at least six ADDs. Improvement must change the factorization, mix components, use extra workspace or change the cost model.
stop_rule: Enumerate the complete GL(4,2) Cayley graph and all 36 invertible anti-diagonal 2x2-block endpoints; stop after independent certificate/source checks. No stochastic search or unbounded expansion.
